assets.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve.
Create ONE photorealistic color portrait of this established fictional adult character in a true THREE-QUARTER view. The task is to show the approved man from a new angle while preserving his specific face and restrained temperament.

REFERENCE PRIORITY:
Image 1 is the primary identity reference and the face to rotate. Preserve its facial width-to-height balance, eye and brow shapes, spacing, nose, mouth width, lips, cheek and jaw proportions, and the recently smoothed but still angular chin.
Image 2 is the SAME MAN under directional light. Use it only to guide the quiet, somber, firmly attentive expression and the coherent broad shadow pattern.
Image 3 supplies supporting nose-lip-chin depth and the practical shorter haircut. It must not override the frontal identity.
Do not beautify, redesign or average the faces.

VIEW:
Turn the approved face toward the viewer's right by approximately 45 degrees, clearly halfway between front and profile. Both eyes remain visible, with the far eye and far cheek distinctly foreshortened; the nose projects across the far cheek without hiding the far eye. Eye-level camera, ordinary portrait lens perspective, vertical 3:4 head-and-upper-chest frame.
The head is upright and supported naturally over the neck, chin level, shoulders settled and uncompressed. His gaze follows the face toward a person at his own eye level just outside the frame. Eyes look horizontally ahead, never upward, never sideways back toward the camera. He is already watching that person steadily, not glancing around or seeking a response.

TEMPERAMENT THROUGH VISIBLE PERFORMANCE:
Composed, inward, emotionally guarded, quietly assessing. He has time to let the other person speak. Brow position stays natural, forehead still, upper eyelids settled rather than lifted; a small amount of focused tension remains around the eyes. Mouth rests neutrally without a smile, pout or pronounced compression. His attention is clear but his reaction is withheld. Preserve the youthful ADULT face; express steadiness through posture and facial control, not added wrinkles or harsh frowning.

IDENTITY DETAILS:
Keep the mouth-to-chin proportions and sufficient substance in the lower face from Image 1. A continuous gently angular chin with a natural hollow below the lower lip; no deep central cleft, detached block-like chin bulge, pointed tapered chin, newly hollow cheeks or receding chin.
Use the short dark waves from Image 3, with modest crown volume and tidy ear/nape length. Gray-dominant pale gray-blue eyes with natural darker rims and restrained reflections.

LIGHT AND SETTING:
Soft directional light from one side, with broad continuous shadows in the eye socket, cheek and beneath the jaw, and enough subtle fill to keep facial anatomy legible. Take the visual restraint of Image 2 with less extreme contrast. Natural skin tone and irregular fine texture. Preserve the black shirt, dark textured jacket and subdued architectural interior. No glossy fashion styling, flirtatious expression, wide-eyed innocence, theatrical villain scowl, added age, text, props or collage. The result should read as the specific approved man pausing in a quiet exchange.

assets.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve.
Re-photograph the SAME fictional adult man in this approved portrait from a clearly different camera angle. This single image is the sole identity and expression reference. Create one color photograph, vertical 3:4, head and upper chest.

Change the VIEW to a definite three-quarter portrait facing the viewer's right, about 45–50 degrees away from frontal. Both eyes are visible, the far eye distinctly foreshortened and the far cheek narrow. Show substantial depth along the nearer cheek and nose. Preserve his actual facial proportions under perspective: the same brow and eyelid shapes, nose, mouth, cheekbones, jaw width, lower-face length and continuous subtly angular chin. Do not invent a narrower, more tapered or more delicate face.

The CAMERA is at his EYE LEVEL. The head is upright, chin level and neck naturally supported, shoulders settled. He looks directly ahead along the direction of his turned face, at another person at the same height. The pupils must NOT look upward. Preserve the reference's concentrated, emotionally withheld expression: eyelids settled, brows still, mouth quiet, attention firmly on the other person. He appears to be silently assessing what he hears, with no need to signal agreement or seek reassurance. Quietly authoritative, inward and somber. Preserve the youthful adult age, without extra wrinkles or an angry frown.

Keep the reference's broad directional SIDE LIGHT and coherent shaded half of the face. Retain depth in the eye socket and cheek with only enough reflected fill for anatomy to remain readable. This is the approved man's subdued expression seen at a different angle, not a bright fashion portrait.
Keep muted pale gray-blue irises, short dark wavy hair with restrained rear volume, natural skin texture, the black shirt and dark textured jacket, and the same subdued architectural background. No change of identity, no cleft or block-like chin, no pointed jaw, no smile, pout, upturned searching glance, text or collage.
